research_question: Does the public Polymarket US inventory contain exactly the same open September 30 US House military-aid contract already retained from Polymarket Global, with source-proved payoff identity sufficient to permit a later separately frozen economics gate?

selection.method: Before any Polymarket US search or economics access, select the objectively resolvable exact-title US House question from the eight matching-topic titles in the retained September 30 Global catalog. Selection used title, rule objectivity, and likely cross-listing only; no candidate economics were inspected.
selection.promotion_safety: The exact title, one request, response limit, exact-title rule, global event identity, implementation, raw path, journal path, and output path are frozen before access. Search-response economics may be retained in raw bytes but may not be printed, used for selection, or treated as executable.
selection.no_substitution: If there is not exactly one exact-title result, stop. Do not search an alias, similar title, sibling, alternate date, or second candidate after observing this response.

exact_title: Will the US House pass a bill restricting military aid to Israel by September 30?

official_sources.claim: Polymarket US documents https://gateway.polymarket.us as its public API base and separates public endpoints from authenticated trading endpoints.
The public GET /v1/search endpoint accepts query and limit parameters and returns an events array.

required: exact normalized event descriptions and resolution sources
exact normalized market questions descriptions and resolution sources
no additional Polymarket US market rules disclaimer
both events active and not closed
payoff_identity_gate.fail_closed: Any absent, ambiguous, additional, or unequal term rejects the family before economics. Matching titles alone never prove matching payoffs.

authority.allowed: One public unauthenticated read-only Polymarket US search GET and zero-network comparison with the hash-bound retained Global catalog.
authority.prohibited: No credentials accounts authentication orders funds transactions price selection BBO order books fee endpoints retries aliases pagination protected capture reads or deployment claims.

retry_policy: This exact search is one-use. Preserve any response or failure and do not retry, alias, paginate, or substitute another candidate after observing it. A passing payoff gate only permits a separately frozen economics test; it never proves executable parity, capacity, atomicity, eligibility, legality, or profit.
